title: Puttering Pebblepuff
statement: A pear-shaped, translucent fish with apricot cheeks and six fluttering fins, the Pebblepuff spends its days blowing careful water-jets at pebbles, arranging them into spirals and doorways it is slightly too round to enter. Its tank is a blue-hour garden of slate arches and pale sand, with one warm shaft of light where it brings each especially interesting stone for a second look.
